verdict.rationale: An uptime SLA and a public status page are fair questions for a SaaS product like Jira Cloud, so the axis applies. The pack has no published uptime commitment and no status page. The only related evidence is a sandbox document noting that sandboxes are 'not covered by the SLA'. That is about another feature and states no uptime figure, so it does not establish this story.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know the vendor's published uptime SLA and can check real-time incident status via a public status page
